- Basic payment of € 14,99 per hour
- Allowances up to 50%

- Travel allowance up from 10 kilometers

First of all you are having a Dutch citizen number and own housing within The Netherlands. Besides that, to start working as a Warehouse Employee at DPD Oirschot we have some requirements:

- You are at least 18 years old
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are available at least 3 days a week

As a warehouse employee at DPD Oirschot you’ll be running through the big warehouse. In this warehouse you are going to load and unload the trucks! Also you need to sort packages by hand. For this you need to be strong. The packages can be heavy! But, you can see it as a free workout! We have two shifts to make some good hours; the afternoon and nighttimes:

- 14:00 - 22:30
- 22:30 - 07:00

Where will you work
In the warehouse of DPD Oirschot! The warehouse is located at Pakket Onderweg just outside Oirschot. The street was invented specially for the warehouse of DPD! In this warehouse you’ll be joining a team of international warehouse employees. Daily they make sure all the packages get sorted on time. Between the hard work there is enough time to have a chat with each other. Maybe you’ll be meeting your new best friend at DPD Oirschot!? #baanrader
